messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout started: service=\"inference-api\" version=\"v2.3.1\" -> 5% traffic. Change window: 03/20 21:00-23:00 UTC. details: https://deploys.redwood.co/abc123
aj: ack, i'll watch p95/5xx dashboards
sre-oncall-bot: Alert: inference-api (canary) 5xx rate increased to 1.9% (1m avg) and error budget burn rising
maria: i'm seeing p95 jump 120ms -> 420ms on canary, traces point to KV cache misses causing long tails
oliver: also seeing OOMs on gpu-2 in the canary pool, stack excerpts:
```
2026-03-20T21:06:12Z inference-runtime gpu-2 OOM at quantize_kernel.cpp:412
2026-03-20T21:06:13Z worker reclaiming cache, retrying request
```
sara: recommend STOP and pin back to v2.3.0. We shouldn't push to 20% while OOMs present
aj: +1 can we freeze any further traffic? deploybot, can you pin/freeze?
deploybot: Action required: roll/pin request received. Options: [ROLLBACK -> v2.3.0] [REGION_PIN -> eu-west-1] [HOLD -> keep at 5%]. Reply with APPROVE <option>.
maria: i'm for full rollback unless runtime has a 5m hotfix
oliver: prefer to hold for 10m to attempt quick patch, but need consensus. Preserve canary logs either way
aj: preserving logs is fine. If rollback is faster we should do that to protect users
sre-oncall-bot: Rollback requires SRE approval. @oncall_sre please review
sara: tagging runtime: @tomas can you weigh in?
tomas: i'm checking pools now. Canary is global 5% across regions. eu-west has majority of errors. Two options: regional drain (eu-west) or global rollback. Regional drain buys time for a targeted fix
maria: regional drain would reduce blast radius. But we risk other regions hitting issues as we increase traffic later
tomas: I can drain eu-west traffic in ~45s. Global rollback estimated 90s end-to-end
aj: tradeoff: quicker global rollback reduces risk. i'll APPROVE ROLLBACK now
deploybot: APPROVE received from aj. Initiating rollback -> v2.3.0. Est. completion 90s.
deploybot: Rollback complete: Canary v2.3.1 -> 0%. Canary now v2.3.0. Monitoring: redeploy hooks triggered.
oliver: confirmed canary now v2.3.0, no ongoing OOMs in canary pool
maria: thanks. please keep canary logs/trace snapshots for RCA
aj: opening follow-up: schedule RCA and patch PR. Also add canary-runbook note to avoid quantized GPU path on tiny batch sizes
sara: change window note: this was inside the 21:00-23:00 window. we'll document in release notes and postmortem. :thumbsup:
deploybot: changelog: canary rollback executed by aj at 2425016865. Incident: https://incidents.redwood.co/INC-2026-234
maria: no customer-facing errors reported so far. marking this as HOLD for 2 hours while RCA completes
tomas: i'll start a staging build with increased batch size and run the quantized path tests
aj: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene once RCA is ready.
sara: thanks — ping me for a re-run decision.
